Level 2 - Beginner 40 min Machine-coding case study Patterns: Strategy, Observer, Builder

Snake & Ladder

The friendliest machine-coding problem, and the one where graders are strictest about clean code. You will model the board as a map instead of 100 objects, put the dice behind a Strategy, run a queue-based game loop, and add the follow-ups (two dice, extra roll on six, play until the last player) without touching code that already works.
